# Roboto Condensed (retired)

Roboto Condensed was the prior deterministic Latin/Cyrillic UI face. It was
removed from runtime Resources on `2026-08-09` after visual review found it too
narrow for the approved gameplay-HUD reference. Helvetica Neue Roman now owns
the runtime typography contract; this note remains only as change provenance.

Google Fonts file revision: `ae50998cbcab558ae1f047ad5c724ec7261980ca`

Runtime TTF SHA-256:
`DACE262AFCEE68A5276F200D8026C57221735C0118AB5FDA8C2C0D3DC409A8D0`

Source: <https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/robotocondensed>

Upstream metadata identified the file as Roboto Condensed Regular with Latin,
Cyrillic and Cyrillic Extended subsets under SIL Open Font License 1.1. The
runtime font and its license file are no longer stored in Resources.
